---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using fictional data
---

## What happened?

Describe expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps with fictional values. Never include credentials, phone
numbers, session strings, account identifiers, or private campaign data.

## Environment

Include the tgads version, runtime version, and operating system.

## Validation

Describe checks already performed. Do not use live spending actions to reproduce.
